title: PortalWarmup
description: Adds a warmup before portal teleports.
body:
# PortalWarmup

Adds a warmup before portal teleports.

## Features
- Delay before portal teleport.
- Cancel if player moves away.
- Configurable warmup time and radius.
- Works for Nether and End portals.

## Command
- `/portalwarmup status | /portalwarmup reload`

## Permissions
- `portalwarmup.use`
- `portalwarmup.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
warmup-seconds: 3
cancel-radius: 2
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
